name: Recipe Builder & Linter
blurb: a BitBake recipe from source, license, build system and packaging choices, with the common mistakes caught
intro: Writes a BitBake recipe from a few choices (source, licence, build class, systemd unit, run-time dependencies) or reads a pasted .bb, splits it into header, fetch, build, install and packaging, and checks it against the rules oe-core enforces: insane.bbclass QA checks, the git fetcher warnings, the ${D} and path-variable conventions and the release-specific S / UNPACKDIR / SRCPV rules.

inputs.label: Yocto release
inputs.help: Changes S for git, SRCPV and UNPACKDIR rules.

inputs.label: SUMMARY
inputs.default: Sensor daemon publishing GPIO and I2C readings over MQTT

inputs.label: Recipe (.bb)
inputs.default:
# gpio-monitor_1.0.bb - watches the door and relay GPIOs
DESCRIPTION = "GPIO monitor daemon for the ACME gateway"
LICENSE = "GPLv2"

SRC_URI = "git://github.com/acme-embedded/gpio-monitor.git \
           file://gpio-monitor.service \
           file://gpio-monitor.conf \
          "
SRCREV = "${AUTOREV}"

DEPENDS = "libgpiod"
RDEPENDS_${PN} = "libgpiod-tools"

do_compile() {
    gcc -o gpio-monitor main.c gpio.c -lgpiod
}

do_install() {
    install -m 0755 gpio-monitor ${D}/usr/bin/gpio-monitor
    install -d ${D}${systemd_system_unitdir}
    install -m 0644 ${WORKDIR}/gpio-monitor.service ${D}${systemd_system_unitdir}
    install -m 0644 ${WORKDIR}/gpio-monitor.conf /etc/gpio-monitor.conf
    install -d ${D}/opt/gpio-monitor
    cp -r ${S}/scripts ${D}/opt/gpio-monitor/
}

SYSTEMD_SERVICE_${PN} = "gpio-monitor.service"
CFLAGS:append = "-DUSE_LIBGPIOD_V2"

usage: mode "lint": give bb (the recipe text) and bbname (name_version.bb) - returns the findings table (line, part, severity, check, message, fix label), counts, and a "Fixed recipe" text with every one-click fix applied. mode "build": give pn, pv, summary, license, licfile+licmd5, source (git|tarball|local) with url/branch/srcrev or sha256, buildsys (cmake|meson|autotools|setuptools3|go-mod|cargo|module|make), depends, rdepends, service, conffile - returns the .bb text and lints it. Set release (kirkstone|scarthgap|walnascar); checksums and upstream files are not verified.
